Hi Sara —

Welcome — we're starting the vendor onboarding for OliveTech so we can set up POs and begin purchasing. To move this along on our side, can you please send the following items back to me (and cc Marcus and Lauren):

- Completed vendor intake spreadsheet (company legal name, remit-to address, tax ID/EIN, billing contact, preferred invoice format)
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (PDF)
- Remit-to address for mailed checks and AR email for e-invoices
- ACH details (bank name, routing number, last 4 of account, name on account) and the ACH authorization form (signed) or a voided check
- Confirmation of payment terms (Net30, Net45, etc.) and preferred invoice PO header (do you require a PO number on the invoice?)

We also have a short vendor agreement/PSA that we can send via DocuSign if you prefer. If you can return the items above by EOD Wednesday (11/5), that will keep us on schedule for the November purchasing window.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15-20 minute call if that helps.

Best,
Kimberly Park

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of quick follow-ups from procurement/AP so we can complete vendor creation in our ERP: 

1) Can you confirm the W-9 legal name exactly matches the legal entity you want us to use for tax reporting (e.g., "OliveTech, Inc." spelled as shown)?
2) For ACH verification, Redwood requires either (a) a signed ACH authorization form + a voided check, or (b) a bank letter on bank letterhead that confirms account ownership. We need one of these to complete setup — can you send the voided check or the bank letter?
3) Please add the bank address (city/state) on the intake spreadsheet next to the routing/account fields — some banks require this for micro-deposit verification.
4) For our PO process: we will issue a Redwood PO number before we submit an invoice. Confirm whether OliveTech invoices should include the PO in the invoice header or line items (you indicated header — that's what we prefer).

I'll also attach a secure upload link for documents that contain bank info — we prefer suppliers to upload signed ACH forms and voided checks there rather than email. Link: https://redwoodinference.app/vendor-portal/oliveTech (secure supplier upload).

If you can send the voided check or signed ACH by EOD Wednesday (11/5), we should be able to issue the first PO next week.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
